system.description: You may "throw" your voice, causing it to emanate from any place within view. This operates independently of you, and you may continue to talk normally while the "thrown" voice chimes in. This power works automatically, but if you wish to undertake any other actions at the same time you must perform a Mental Challenge; success indicates you can divide your concentration. (This power is listed as an additional Basic-level Melpominee power in this supplement, learned in sequence with the Discipline's other Basic powers.)
